mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_order_list(user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, activity_name, goods_id, goods_name, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status, out_trade_no, biz_id, pay_no, pay_amount, pay_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{teamId}, #{orderId}, #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalPrice}, #{deductionPrice}, #{payPrice}, #{status}, #{outTradeNo}, #{bizId}, #{payNo}, #{payAmount}, #{payTime}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, activity_name, goods_id, goods_name, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status, out_trade_no, biz_id, pay_no, pay_amount, pay_time, create_time, update_time from group_buy_order_list where user_id = #{userId} and out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
